expected_effect: Add comprehensive dependency audit skill (outdated, license, security) to deepen security capabilities
rationale: Evolver's innovation catalyst recommended security deepening. Existing dependency-scanner only covers CVE; we need full dependency health assessment including outdated versions and license compliance to fill ecosystem gap.

strategy: For each dependency, fetch latest version from npm registry
Parse package licenses from package.json or npm
Run npm ls to get dependency tree depth
Compute health score based on outdated count, license restrictions, tree depth
Generate upgrade recommendations and license warning report

summary: 创建 comprehensive dependency auditor 技能，提供依赖过期、许可证合规、安全漏洞的综合审计。
